name: The Boys Presents: Diabolical
description: From some of the most unhinged and maniacal minds in Hollywood today comes this animated anthology series, a collection of irreverent and emotionally shocking animated short films. Each episode plunges elbow-deep into unseen crevices of The Boys Universe.

videos.title: Laser Baby's Day Out
videos.overview: Laser eyes plus a cute baby equals an evisceration machine that will melt your heart. Before burning it out of your chest. With her laser eyes.

videos.title: An Animated Short Where Pissed-Off Supes Kill Their Parents
videos.overview: The title says it all and kinda gives away the ending. Let’s just say it’s cathartic and messy.

videos.title: I’m Your Pusher
videos.overview: Ripped from the pages of the original THE BOYS comics - Billy Butcher, with Terror in tow, terrorizes a narcotics supplier into spiking a certain supe’s fix.

videos.title: Boyd in 3D
videos.overview: Social media is a dysmorphic lens that warps how we view ourselves and others and numbs us to what’s truly important in life. This is about that.

videos.title: BFFS
videos.overview: Inject Compound V and get superpowers. Drink compound V and uh… this happens.

videos.title: Nubian vs Nubian
videos.overview: Divorce is complicated. Divorce with a kid, even more so. Superheroes getting divorced with a kid who’s determined for that NOT to happen? There will be blood…

videos.title: John and Sun-Hee
videos.overview: Put on your crying face for this one as an elderly man risks everything to cure his wife’s inoperable cancer.

videos.title: One Plus One Equals Two
videos.overview: Even a great American hero like Homelander had to start somewhere…

awards: Won 1 Primetime Emmy. 1 win & 5 nominations total
